import sys
import bisect

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    
    mod1 = 998244353
    mod2 = 1000000007
    
    val = [[] for _ in range(10)]
    sum_arr = [0] * 10
    Pow = [1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000]
    
    cnt1 = 0
    cnt2 = 0
    ans = 0
    
    def check(x):
        now = 1000000
        return x * now + 999999 <= n and x * now * 10 > n
    
    def dfs1(x1, x2):
        nonlocal cnt1
        if x1 == 7:
            return
        val[x1].append((cnt1 - x2 + mod1) % mod1)
        sum_arr[x1] += (cnt1 - x2 + mod1) % mod1
        cnt1 += 1
        for i in range(10):
            dfs1(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i)
    
    def dfs2(x1, x2):
        nonlocal cnt2, ans
        if x2 > n:
            return
        if check(x2):
            for i in range(7):
                now = ((cnt2 + 1 - (x2 * Pow[i])) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1
                pos = bisect.bisect_left(val[i], (mod1 - now))
                ans += (sum_arr[i] + now * len(val[i]) - mod1 * (len(val[i]) - pos))
                ans %= mod2
            cnt2 += cnt1
        else:
            cnt2 += 1
            ans += ((cnt2 - x2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1
            for i in range(0 if x1 == 0 else 0, 10):
                dfs2(x1 + 1, x2 * 10 + i)
    
    dfs1(0, 0)
    for i in range(7):
        val[i].sort()
    cnt2 = -1
    dfs2(0, 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
